symbols.name: log-length parameter
symbols.meaning: The rounded-up base-2 logarithm of the input length $n$.
symbols.quote: Write $b = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$ for the rounded-up base-2 logarithm of $n$.

symbols.name: working precision
symbols.meaning: The precision parameter $p = 6b$, which sets the coefficient width up to a constant factor.
symbols.quote: Write $p = 6b$ for the working precision, the parameter that sets the coefficient width up to a constant factor, so $p = \Theta(\log n)$.

symbols.name: padded box size
symbols.meaning: The power of two that sets the number of cells in the padded box.
symbols.quote: Write $T$ for the power of two that sets the number of cells in the padded box (the array the algorithm works on), with $4n/b \le T < 8n/b$.

symbols.name: logical volume
symbols.meaning: The number of logical bits in the padded box, $V = Tp$.
symbols.quote: Write $V = Tp$ for the logical bit volume of the padded box, so $V = \Theta(n)$.

symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the padded box.
symbols.quote: Write $d$ for the number of axes of the padded box, with $d = \lfloor b^{\epsilon} \rfloor = \Theta(p^{\epsilon})$.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each address chunk.
symbols.quote: Write $K = \lfloor d^{c} \rfloor = \Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$ for the width of the address chunks, in bits.

symbols.name: longest axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of cells along the longest axis of the padded box.
symbols.quote: Write $r$ for the largest axis length of the padded box, a power of two.

symbols.name: log axis length
symbols.quote: Write $\ell = \log_2 r = \Theta(p^{1-\epsilon})$ for its base-2 logarithm.

symbols.name: size exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive rational exponent that sets $d$ and $K$.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\epsilon$ is a fixed positive rational number.

symbols.name: chunk exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive rational exponent that sets $K$ relative to $d$.
symbols.quote: The exponent $c$ is a fixed positive rational number.

symbols.name: exchange exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed rational exponent between zero and one in the cost of chunk exchanges.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\tau$ is a fixed rational number between zero and one.

symbols.name: butterfly exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed rational exponent below one in the cost of a simultaneous butterfly round.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\lambda'$ is a fixed rational number below one.

symbols.name: arithmetic exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed rational exponent in the powers of $p$ that bound the arithmetic costs.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\delta$ is a fixed rational number.

symbols.name: line cost factor
symbols.meaning: The factor, of order $p^{1/4+\epsilon/2}$, in the cost of the Gaussian line maps.
symbols.quote: The factor $\alpha = \Theta(p^{1/4+\epsilon/2})$ is the factor in the cost of the Gaussian line maps.

relations.quote: The cost table splits the [running time cost](running-time-cost.md) of the algorithm into separate terms, one for each kind of work.
